literal: In the proper measure having stood behaving they are unable, in theft those with intense desire.
translation: Those who have an intense desire for theft cannot stand firm and conduct themselves within proper bounds.
modern: திருடுவதில் மிகுந்த ஆசை கொண்டவர்கள், சரியான நெறிமுறையின் எல்லையில் நின்று வாழும் திறனற்றவர்கள் ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet explains how the desire to steal corrupts a person's overall conduct. The word 'அளவு' refers to the proper limits or boundaries of righteous behavior. Those described as having an intense, deep-rooted craving for theft are consumed by this desire. Consequently, they lose the ability to stand firm and live within the bounds of a measured, ethical life.
